verdict.rationale: Missive ships its own rules engine. Pricing lists "Rules & automations" with "Up to 1000 rules". The changelog describes multi-step rules that wait, check conditions and act on a conversation (label, notify, reassign), and rules can create drafts; AI rules are also mentioned. Missing for 10: a documented list of event triggers and available actions, in-depth rule-builder documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote:
Automate your workflows

Up to 1000 rules
Rules can now run in steps over time. Each step waits, checks its own conditions, then acts on the same conversation.
Escalate unanswered support emails: label at 24 hrs, notify the lead at 48, reassign at 72.
Drafts created outside the composer, by the assistant, by a rule, or through the API and MCP server
Your AI rules, saved models, and assistant conversations stay intact
